report.notes: R7-01 (uri_web/untrusted.py): any bracket or quote mark from any script (Ps/Pi/Pe/Pf, ASCII quotes, other non-dot marks) on BOTH sides of a dot or 'dot', with optional spaces, is a separator; dot runs may contain spaces ('. .'); 'd o t' is spelt-out dot; symbols named BULLET/DOT/CIRCLE/SPOT/RING OPERATOR (including category So: U+25E6, U+25CF) count as dots; a mark then a space before a common domain ending (com|net|org|gov|edu|mil|int|info|biz|arpa|io|xyz, any case) or before any known ending followed by '/path' is a link (new _SPACED_MARK), so 'portal, com', 'portal: com', 'portal; com/claim', 'portal! com/claim' are caught. Remaining gap for the owner ledger: another domain ending after a comma or colon and a space with no path ('portal, shop'), alongside D13's 'portal. Com'. Cost: some ordinary text is now flagged ('profits, net of tax'); prose link checks are about 1.7x slower, still linear. R7-02 (uri_web/synthesize.py): new _DETERMINER_SENSITIVE list (little, few, bit, lot, number, deal, most, other, ...); _excerpt no longer lets a claim add, or the source drop, a determiner directly before these words (in match, gap_ok and lead_ok), so such claims are quoted word for word. Verified: the new test file fails on f604e7cd (R7-01 and R7-02 cases) and all 108 pass after; tests/web + tests/assist: 3188 passed. tests/phase2a/test_frozen_core.py::test_base_commit_is_the_one_the_checkpoint_was_built_on fails both before and after (it expects the checked-out commit to start with e8e3b65; about which commit is checked out, not this code). Existing slowdown not addressed (not in scope): mask_links('a '+'('*50000) takes about 55 s both before and after the change. graphify not run, as instructed.
